_about: Food-safety chart: minimum safe internal temperatures, measured with a probe thermometer in the thickest part. Values are the USDA FSIS safe minimum internal temperature chart converted to Celsius (165°F = 74°C, 160°F = 71°C, 145°F = 63°C). These are the numbers the assistant must state; 'cooked through', 'juices run clear' or 'golden' are never a substitute.

categories.note: Whole birds: check the thickest part of the thigh, not touching bone.
Grinding spreads surface bacteria through the meat, so mince needs a higher temperature than whole cuts.
Rest at least 3 minutes before carving.
Or until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
